description: Use this when someone wants a shared calendar that a group subscribes to: a team practice schedule, class timetable, club or family events. Publishes a page with the upcoming events and subscribe links (webcal, Google Calendar add-by-URL) to a live iCalendar feed. Takes 1-200 events in one IANA time zone, with optional weekly repeats and skipped dates; events can run up to one year ahead. Returns the public link and a private organizer link. Does not send invitations, reminders or emails, and does not write into anyone's calendar directly.

description.description: Short description shown on the page and in calendar apps, e.g. Practice schedule for the U12 team.

all_day.description: true for an all-day event (no times), e.g. true.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes instead of an end time, e.g. 90. Default 60.

end.description: Local end time HH:MM, e.g. 19:00. An end earlier than the start means the next day. Or use duration_minutes.

end_date.description: For an all-day event over several days, the last day YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2026-11-22.

location.description: Place in words, e.g. Field 2, Riverside Park. No links.

note.description: Short note, e.g. Bring shin guards.

repeat_weekly_until.description: Repeat every week on the same weekday until this date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), e.g. 2027-01-26.

skip_dates.description: Dates of a weekly series to leave out, e.g. ["2026-12-22"].

start.description: Local start time HH:MM in the calendar's time zone, e.g. 17:30. Omit for an all-day event.

name.description: Calendar name people will see in their calendar app, e.g. U12 soccer practice.

organizer_name.description: Organizer's first name shown on the page, e.g. Coach Sam.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the event times, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/Chicago.

name: create_group_calendar
title: Create group calendar
